title: maple.config.json
description: Per-project config read by every maple-standard plugin command/hook. Canonical shape per docs/standard-architecture.md (project/repo/worktrees/docs/ci/lint/sizeCaps/errorTracker/loops), plus plugin-specific operational extensions nested under the same canonical top-level blocks (never a competing top-level block — see plugin/README.md 'Schema reconciliation'). Every key is optional except project.name/project.slug; omitted keys fall back to documented defaults.

root.description: Absolute, or relative to the repo root. Default ".worktrees" — inside the repo, gitignored (maple-start self-heals the .gitignore entry).

ephemeralPaths.description: plugin extension — doc-relative paths (under docs.root) that own no code and so are exempt from the drift gate's point-to-code anchor check, e.g. a session-state folder. Default [].

verification.description: The /heal fix-verify ladder (t1-t5) — deliberately namespaced under errorTracker, not ci.tiers, to avoid colliding with the wt-land gate tiers (docs/decisions.md D002-D011 reconciliation, #T11).

toolCalls.description: plugin extension (re-review B2) — plugin/hooks/loop-budget-guard.mjs's own runaway backstop, counting RAW TOOL CALLS (every Bash/Read/Edit/etc. within the cycle). A DIFFERENT UNIT from `turns` (loop iterations, enforced separately by each command's own `budget.mjs check --used $ITER` calls, never by this hook) — do not confuse the two. Default 400, deliberately generous.

weights.description: plugin extension (docs/tasks.md #T8) — loop name -> pick-loop.mjs round-robin weight, default 1 for every enabled loop. Object keys are validated against the loops.enabled name set by validate-config.mjs (JSON Schema alone can't express that cross-check).

cooldownCycles.description: plugin extension (docs/tasks.md #T8) — how many ledger cycles a loop that just reported "quiet" is skipped for by pick-loop.mjs. Default 3; 0 disables cooldown.

sessionCap.description: plugin extension (docs/tasks.md #T8) — /dev-burner's optional global budget (orchestrator step 2). Unset = no session cap; the standing /loop session's own stop mechanism is the only ceiling.

jev.description: plugin extension — Jev (TypeSafe System One) decision-model integration: model routing, skill selection, search decisions, and SubagentStop validation. See plugin/README.md 'Jev' section.

enabled.description: Default true. Every jev.* call still fails open (allow / fall back to sonnet) with no key configured, so leaving this true costs nothing on a project with no TypeSafe key.

credentialTarget.description: OS credential-store target name to try FIRST (plugin/scripts/jev/client.mjs then tries 'Maple-TypeSafe-APIKey', then 'MapleLens-TypeSafe-APIKey'). Default null.

confidenceFloor.description: Default 0.5 — the confidence below which a Jev choice answer is treated as 'don't know' and the caller falls back to its own default. jev-model-routing uses its own separate, higher constant (ladder.mjs ESCALATION_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR, 0.8) for escalating past the default executor — not configurable via this key.

timeoutMs.description: Default 3000 — fail-open budget per Jev call. Deliberately short: these calls run inline in a hook or skill and must never be worth blocking a turn over.

credentialCacheTtlSeconds.description: Default 300 — how long client.mjs's DPAPI-encrypted per-user credential cache stays fresh before the next call re-reads Windows Credential Manager directly. 0 disables the cache.

quality.description: plugin extension — code-quality gates. See plugin/scripts/jev/audit/README.md and docs/decisions.md D051 (gates are canonically owned by the plugin, ported from MapleLens's tools/jev/audit.mjs).

jevAudit.description: Per-function Jev code-quality audit/gate config. Every key optional; an absent block (or enabled:false) means /wt-land and /quality-gate skip the gate entirely. Defaults documented in plugin/scripts/jev/audit/config.mjs.

enabled.description: Default false (opt-in — a fresh adopter should not silently start sending source to a third-party model). maple-land skips the quality-gate landing step entirely when this is false.

slug.description: Namespaces this config's cache/report under .maplelens/audit/<slug>/ (or the plugin's own per-user state dir when that path isn't gitignored). Default: project.slug.

baseBranch.description: Explicit base branch for changed-function scoping. Default: the landing target passed by maple-land, else repo.devBranch, else "main".

denylistPatterns.description: Case-insensitive regex patterns matched against a file path or function name; a match means the function's source is NEVER sent to Jev.

moduleLabels.description: scopeDirs entry -> report heatmap label override, for scopeDirs that would otherwise collapse to the same top-level segment.

thresholds.description: Blocking-rule constants for --gate mode. Uncalibrated (docs/decisions.md D051's porting brief) — env-overridable per constant, see plugin/scripts/jev/audit/config.mjs.

predeploy.description: plugin extension (D060) — the ENFORCED pre-deploy gate. checks[] (command | preset | github), an expiring allowlist, a deploy guard (PreToolUse), an emergency override (default off) and the aggressive live ZAP scan policy. Authoritative validation: plugin/scripts/predeploy/config.mjs. See docs/predeploy-gate.md.

policyRef.description: Decision id the project's policy is recorded under.

allowlist.description: Repo-relative path of the committed allowlist. Default predeploy-allowlist.json.

github.description: Workflow file (workflow_dispatch) for remote-only checks; requires `why`.

liveScan.description: Aggressive post-deploy ZAP active scan of the live targets. Guards: noRealCustomerCredentials + noPstnCalls (callOriginationExcludes).
